notes.title: Attention Nexomon Trainers – Prequel Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36192113/c57b6d6e23aad4d0d06fed62f9413218309c417b.png[/img]

Attention Nexomon Trainers – Prequel Available Now!

We are thrilled to announce that Nexomon, the prequel to acclaimed monster-catcher Nexomon: Extinction, is now available to purchase on all current and next-gen consoles for the very first time.
Get ready to explore a world where you can catch, evolve, and collect over 300 unique Nexomon! Embark on an epic journey and build your ultimate team to take on powerful tamers and their fearsome Nexomon.

BECOME A HERO

Choose from seven unique starter Nexomon to begin your journey. Build a formidable team to take on powerful foes and save the world from the merciless Nexolord!

LET THE BATTLES BEGIN
Take part in thrilling 2D animated turn-based battles against wild Nexomon, fellow tamers, and legendary champions! You’ll need to master the seven elemental types to have the advantage in battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36192113/fc75f779750a1f48844b87c74fedb1764ce2e04a.jpg[/img]

BUILD YOUR TEAM

Weaken wild Nexomon to capture them and add them to your team. With over 300 Nexomon to find, there are plenty of options to customize your team to your liking.

DISCOVER THE WORLD OF NEXOMON

From thick forests to dangerous volcanoes and beautiful snowscapes - each area is teeming with Nexomon. Catch, train, and evolve your Nexomon as you travel across ten different regions with your companions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36192113/aaa9e136278239d238a384cba96284a1ee7727c4.jpg[/img]

MEET FRIENDS, BATTLE FOES

Every city, town, and outpost is inhabited by a raft of unique characters - each with their own story to tell. Some will be loyal allies. Others will try to stop you in your tracks...  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36192113/02fa99fd34671a7963bf1166cb35da207060be75.jpg[/img]

For more information and purchase links visit our website:
https://pqube.co.uk/nexomon-original/

notes.title: New BETA build available!
notes.content:
Hello Tamers!

Today a new BETA build for NEXOMON is available on Steam! We know our community have been waiting for an update and now that our translators are finally free we managed to translate Nexomon to more languages as promised!

On behalf of the NEXOMON team, we apologize for the delay and we are grateful to all of you for your patience. 

In this update, we added the following new content just for you:

+ A NEW WIND LEGENDARY Nexomon is now available to be caught! Luhava can appear anywhere at random, but the chances are low unless you have captured plenty of Nexomon. The more unique Nexomon you own, the higher will be the apparition rate of Luhava.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36192113/38e45f8c19d207df72368b592175e86a5d8f1c41.png[/img]

+ We added a new pet for you to unlock in your profile: Luhava!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36192113/abbb6c5ff9f9022ba32c09c9c059ca40cb8f644d.png[/img]

+ We decided to redesign some of the common monsters and also gave them a small upgrade!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36192113/8ef9e9b8b5b2b43d42a0f9997bf45b651f7f7c24.png[/img]

Other changes:

+ French localization added.
+ German localization added.
+ Spanish (LATAM) localization added.
+ Chinese (simplified) localization added.
+ Grinding: enemies will now yield 50% more EXP.
+ Status Effects: they can now last from 1 to 3 turns, as opposed to just one turn
+ Dialogues are much faster now.
+ Various common monsters were graphically updated.
+ EXP Share and EXP Multiplier items will further boost the EXP gained by 30%.
+ Fixed an issue that caused Wardens to be marked as "defeated" despite having lost to them.
+ Remove the action button from appearing in front of Ivan's gym buddies, since they don't trigger dialogues.

To play the BETA release, right click on STEAM > Properties > Beta > Select Branch. 
We hope you keep enjoying the game!

Thank you!

- The Nexomon Team

notes.title: New update available now.
notes.content:
Hi!

This patch includes:

+ [CHANGE] The default volume level for music and effects is now 50%. All save files prior to this update will be automatically set to 50%.

+ [FEATURE] A tooltip will now appear on top-left of screen with the name, description, power and accuracy of the selected skill during battle.

+ [FEATURE] You can now sort your storage by Name, Level, Rarity and Element.

+ [BUG] Fixed Steam Achievements in-game popup. Achievements were being unlocked only after closing the game, but now you should see the notification immediately.

+ [BUG] We may have fixed an issue causing the volleyball minigame to be exceedingly sped up on some devices.

+ [BUG] Some NPCs reference NexoBoxes from the mobile version of the game.

notes.title: BETA Build available now (with improvements & fixes).
notes.content:
Hi!

This patch includes:

+ [IMPROVEMENT] During battles, the game now remembers the last skill you selected.
+ [IMPROVEMENT] Added a new setting to let the game continue running in the background. Enabled by default.

+ [CHANGE] The game now uses borderless fullscreen mode instead of exclusive fullscreen. This might also fix some startup crashes.

+ [FIX] Some skills didn't flash the screen when they should have.
+ [FIX] The evolution scene played music at full volume regardless of your settings.
+ [FIX] The credits scene played music at full volume regardless of your settings.

If no new issues are brought up from this build, we will release it to the public tomorrow or during the weekend. We are still working on more improvements, thanks so much for sharing your feedback!

Tip: To access beta build, go to "Nexomon">right-click>"BETAS"> and download.

notes.title: Update with settings and other fixes available now.
notes.content:
This update includes:

Features:
- Settings button in the Nexopad.
- Sound and music options.
- Option to toggle text sound on/off.
- Option to toggle full screen/windowed mode.
- Option to quit game.

Bugs:
- Slow downs caused by particles fixed (like the Ventra scene and snow areas).
- Catch rate rebalanced.
- Normalized sound effects.

More coming soon!

Thanks for helping us make Nexomon a better experience :) !

notes.title: Cut scenes issue fixed!
notes.content:
Hi! The issue where some users got stuck when entering cut scenes has been solved with the most recent update (special thanks to the community for helping us solve it!). This issue caused other minor bugs but all related to the same problem affecting specific regions.

We are now gathering suggestions and plan to implement them in future updates. 

Including:

-Sound, resolution and windowed options.
-Option to exit game (in-game).
-Sound calibration.
-Default Nexomon skill, where the last skills used will be selected by default.
-Delay when skipping text.
-We are also working on implementing translations asap.

Thanks for helping us make Nexomon a better experience :) !

notes.content:
